content.rendered:
Another new Psiphon pro handler 142 has surfaced with new features including Google DNS in the apk.The Handler interface of the new Psiphon is different from others, it is simple and unique to navigate and setup , it is also known as GMC psiphon 142.

Features of Psiphon Handler 142

– New Handler menu with child lock

– Google DNS 1 and 2 (8.8.8.8 and 8.8.4.4) option

– Real proxy server and port

– Proxy Server type

– Proxy Server

– Handler Ui 502

– More option tab

– Normal Psiphon Server up to 7 etc

Download

Psiphon Handler pro 142 ➡ Psiphon Handler Pro 142.apk

Settings

To set up the new Psiphon is very easy, it is either you use it normal and connect it or you look for a working proxy server.
